The issuer exhibits exceptionally strong profitability with an operating margin of 33% ($1,572M) and solid capitalization, supported by a healthy equity base ($7,253M) and substantial retained earnings ($4,042M). However, its short-term liquidity is constrained, as evidenced by a current ratio of 0.79 ($1,047M in current assets against $1,322M in current liabilities), which introduces refinancing risk and prevents a prime investment-grade rating. Balancing the robust profitability and moderate leverage against the weak short-term liquidity profile places the issuer in the strong, mid-investment-grade category.

DECISION: A-
